entry.intro: No sign-up. Pick a nickname and step in. Everyone shares one room, and nobody knows who you are.
entry.nicknameHint: 2 to 10 characters: Chinese, letters or numbers
entry.privacy: Everyone can read what you write here. Don't share anything private.
entry.demo: Demo mode: messages stay in your browser

errors.chars: Use only Chinese characters, letters and numbers.
errors.NICKNAME_TAKEN: That nickname is in use. Pick another one.
errors.NICKNAME_RESERVED: That nickname was just used and is held for its owner for about 5 minutes. Pick another one, or try again later.
errors.CONNECTION_FAILED: Can't connect. Please try again later.

room.emptyBody:
You're the first one here. Say hello,
someone may drop by.
room.failed: Failed to send. Tap to retry
room.placeholderDesktop: Say something… (Enter to send, Shift + Enter for a new line)
